DUNEDIN GROUP LEADERSHIP COURSE YEARS 12 & 13 – This course will show you how different leadership styles, skills and communication, can be adapted to safely engage and motivate others. You will work in teams to plan and lead interactive activity sessions that meet the specific target group. This two-day course is run at 'The Learning Place' premises at 453 Princes Street, on the 2nd and 3rd of June from 9am – 3pm. It has 13 level 3 credits attached to it, and is also a great course to add to your CV. If you would like more information or to register for this course, please contact Mrs Elder at pathways@kingshigh.school.nz.

DEFENSIVE DRIVING COURSE – Mrs Elder is now taking names for the 2026 Term Two Defensive Driving Course. The course is run here at King's High School in Room 28 from 3:00pm – 5:15pm. The cost for the course is $70 per student. PLEASE NOTE: You must have held your learner's license for at least 3 months, and you must be able to commit to both session days of the course. The course dates are Monday the 25th and Wednesday the 27th of May from 3pm – 5:15pm. Theoretical sessions are Thursday the 28th and Friday the 29th of May and Practical Drive Sessions run during school hours. Please register your interest (including your mobile number) with Mrs Elder at pathways@kingshigh.school.nz.
